SOLAR RELIGHTING DIRECTIVE (5800K High clear sun with short vertical shadows and neutral daylight):

Hollow masonry obelisk measuring 169 meters in vertical height, constructed from honed white Texas marble at the base with a pronounced chromatic masonry joint line at 46 meters transitioning to Cockeysville dolomitic marble ashlar terminating in a sharp stone pyramidion. Deciduous tree stands composed of mature Ulmus americana, Quercus phellos, and Platanus occidentalis display dense late-summer canopies of deep olive green with faint foliar wear. Static civil fabric free of pedestrians and vehicles.
